description: (Na)₂NaBiF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaBiF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaBiF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.23 Å. Bi is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form BiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Bi-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Bi atom.
